title: Zinc-integrated PLGA/chitosan nanofiber mesh: a platform for wound healing applications
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,38846-38864
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA03639A, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Dekonti Davies, Alexis Moody, Sita Shrestha, Reedwan Bin Zafar Auniq, Kiran Subedi, Jagannathan Sankar, Narayan Bhattarai
Zn-integrated PLGA and PLGA–chitosan electrospun nanofibers combine structural strength with bioactivity. Controlled Zn2+ release from the fibers enhances cell proliferation and antimicrobial effects, offering a promising platform for bioresorbable wound dressings.
